name: foryou
description: FOR YOU — Egyptian import marketplace. Modular-monolith monorepo (npm workspaces).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api --if-present && npm run test -w apps/web --if-present
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset -w apps/api && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
